t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm limestone reading sheet with square corners. A small breadcrumb with slash separators over a hairline rule, then a large light-weight sans headline in sentence case. In the centre, a flat 2D hairline schematic of a process train, tanks, vessels, a column and a rack of tubes joined by thin right-angled pipes, with small numbers on its parts. Numbered callouts flank it on both sides, each a mono number, sans title and short note for <CONTENT>, joined to the drawing by dot-ended hairline leader lines. Calm, precise.
signature_idea: Five upfront decisions are pinned to the plant itself: numbered callouts on both sides with leader lines into the schematic.
strengths: callouts-into-drawing is a clear, buildable explainer pattern
light headline, mono numbers and limestone/navy fit the brand
decisions are tied to physical parts
weaknesses: numbering is broken: callout 03 duplicated, six callouts for five decisions, drawing numbers do not match
leader lines end at arbitrary points, not the parts named
rounded card corners and drop shadow break the square, flat rules
requested navy band absent; no steel-blue accent beyond faint numbers
brand_fit_why: Limestone, navy, light headline, mono numbers and calm space fit, but broken numbering, rounded shadowed card and no accent reduce precision.
